in_marathi.name: Vaibhavraj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Radiant, Prosperous, King
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vaibhavraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Vaibhavraj is a name of Sanskrit origin, derived from the words 'vaibhav' (radiant, prosperous) and 'raj' (king). In Hindu mythology, Vaibhavraj is believed to represent the divine ruler of prosperity and success.
